answer.short:
Upper arch with endpoints $(1,1)$ and $(3,1)$ and maximum $(2,3)$.

Dilate horizontally by $\frac12$, translate right $2$ units, then up $1$ unit.
answer.worked:
Write $2x-4=2(x-2)$. Replace $x$ by $2x$ to dilate horizontally by $\frac12$, then replace $x$ by $x-2$ to translate right $2$ units. Finally replace $y$ by $y-1$ to translate up $1$ unit.
$$\begin{align*}y&=f(2x)\\y&=f\bigl(2(x-2)\bigr)\\y&=f\bigl(2(x-2)\bigr)+1\end{align*}$$
Each original point $(u,v)$ moves to $\left(\frac{u}{2}+2,v+1\right)$. The endpoints become $(1,1)$ and $(3,1)$, and the maximum becomes $(2,3)$. Sketch the transformed arch through these points.
